segments: Am I in a cult? Many times, Israelites
are accused of being in a cult when they
turn away from Christianity and coming
to the truth. But let's find out what is
a cult according to worldly terms. Cult.
A relatively small group of people
having religious beliefs or practices
regarded by others as strange or
sinister. So according to that
definition, you are in a cult when you
do something that's considered strange
to others or outsiders. Seeing then we
understand that this people alone,
talking about the Israelites, is
continually in opposition unto all men,
this is key, differing in the strange
